title: papaver dubium proles collinum
intro: Papaver dubium proles collinum, commonly known as the lesser meadow poppy, is a species of poppy plant that belongs to the Papaveraceae family. It is native to Europe and is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Papaver dubium proles collinum include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as protopine, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, pain relief, and antioxidant activity.
